assets.description: Low-poly raised forest diorama with stone roads, bridge, ponds, terrace and seven empty square pads. The full map is a 2D pre-rendered sprite, not runtime 3D terrain.
assets.promptSummary: Use the supplied low-poly diorama reference, high overhead orthographic camera, slight yaw, a thick rectangular grass-tile island with one winding S road and seven empty pads; no units, buildings or UI; transparent outside.
assets.import: Single Sprite; 1672x941; original generated PNG, no pixel edits.

assets.description: 3x3 transparent low-poly atlas: arrow tower, crystal tower, cannon, damage, attack speed, range, gold, repair, wave emblem.
assets.promptSummary: Nine isolated low-poly forest kingdom icons, equal 3x3 cells, warm upper-left light, sandstone/blue/teal/brass, transparent background, no text.
assets.import: Texture2D; NPOT scaling disabled; runtime Sprite cells, no pixel edits.

assets.description: Pine-green and antique-brass panel with faceted stone corner joints, used by HUD, buttons and upgrade cards.
assets.promptSummary: A square front-facing nine-slice UI panel; quiet deep forest green center, straight edges, small brass and stone corner joints, transparent outside; no text or symbols.
assets.import: Single Sprite; 180px borders; sliced Image, pixelsPerUnitMultiplier=7; original generated PNG.
